scientific_integrity: Proof gives universal quantified conclusion, finite checker is non-exhaustive corroboration. No experimental intervention efficacy claim.
scientific_limitations: Exact for a tree with symmetric star communities, homogeneous independent transmissibility, one uniform seed after one perfect removal, and finite mean outbreak objective; no guarantee for heterogeneous graphs, imperfect vaccination, or multiple seeds. Historical novelty remains provisional.
title: A sharp hub-to-corridor vaccination transition in two-community transmission trees
